gloss: homebody; reluctant to go out; staying in

definitions.gloss: homebody; reluctant to go out; stay-at-home disposition
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who prefers to stay at home and is reluctant or lazy about going outside. Can refer to the person themselves or to the tendency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出不精|でぶしょう}だ。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{出不精|でぶしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: I tend to become a homebody in winter.

examples.japanese: {出不精|でぶしょう}な⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誘|さそ}って→誘う：01947_sasou⟧、⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I coaxed my stay-at-home husband into going shopping for the first time in a while.

notes:
Composed of {出|で} (going out) + ⟦{不精|ぶしょう}→不精：28186_bushou⟧ (laziness, indolence). ⟦{不精|ぶしょう}→不精：28186_bushou⟧ can also be written {無精|ぶしょう}. The word describes a mild, relatable personality trait rather than a harsh criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出不精|でぶしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become a homebody
- {出不精|でぶしょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a stay-at-home type
- {出不精|でぶしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す — to overcome one's reluctance to go out

USAGE:
Often used self-deprecatingly to describe oneself. The tone is light and conversational. Particularly common when talking about seasonal changes (⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出不精|でぶしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧) or as a gentle complaint about a partner or family member.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インドア⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ — indoor type (modern, casual equivalent)
- ⟦{引|ひ}きこもり→引きこもり：10491_hikikomori⟧ — shut-in (much stronger; implies social withdrawal, not just a preference for staying home)
